subject: Vendor portal artifact timestamping and SIG artifact bundle instructions
messages:
From: Alan Wu <alan.wu@brightleaf.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: vendr-support@vendr.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Brightleaf SIG bundle + timestamping requirement

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Brightleaf's procurement security checklist we need a SIG (ver 1.5) export and accompanying artifact bundle that includes cryptographic hashes and a timestamped assertion for proof-of-possession. Our legal team requires time-bound proof that the artifacts were in your custody on or before 2028-06-22.

Two asks: 
1) Can you upload a single manifest CSV to Vendr that lists the SIG export filename, the CAIQ PDF (if produced), and the S3 presigned URLs for each artifact? Please indicate size and md5/sha256 in the manifest.
2) We require a signed timestamp assertion or a file with UTC RFC3339 timestamps for each artifact along with the hash values. If Vendr can host the files and show upload timestamps that works too.

If possible, please include a short README describing how the artifacts map to SIG control IDs so our auditors can quickly crosswalk.

Alan
Alan Wu
Security & Procurement
Brightleaf, Inc.
[Attachment: brightleaf-sig-req.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]
From: priya.natarajan@redwood.com <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alan Wu <alan.wu@brightleaf.com>
Cc: vendr-support@vendr.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brightleaf SIG bundle + timestamping requirement

Alan — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. High-level plan:

- We will export the SIG/CAIQ artifacts and produce a single manifest CSV that includes filename, size, sha256, and our Vendr object URLs.
- For timestamping, we'll generate an "artifact-timestamps.jsonl" (each line: filename, sha256, UTC timestamp) and produce an HMAC-signed bundle and an internal notarization PDF that shows the upload times.
- We'll upload everything to your Vendr profile and share presigned links.

Action items (internal):
- Mina: run the SIG export and generate sig_manifest.csv (include control mapping column).
- Irene: coordinate Vendr upload + presigned URL window and confirm server-side upload timestamps are visible in the portal.
- Priya: produce the notarization PDF and send to Brightleaf once uploads are complete.

I'll follow up with the manifest and the presigned links once Mina and Irene confirm.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor-portal-checklist-template.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

Priya / Irene — quick status.

- SIG export: completed. Files produced: 2028-06-21_SIG-export.json, caiq-2028-06-21.pdf.
- Manifest: attached (sig_manifest.csv) — columns: filename, size_bytes, sha256, control_map (comma-separated), vendr_path. Sample row included.
- Hashes: produced artifact-hashes.txt (sha256sum format).

Notes on timestamping: Vendr records the object creation time (UTC) for uploads; however, to be safe for audit we prepared an "artifact-timestamps.jsonl" where each line is: filename | sha256 | 2028-06-21T15:32:41Z. We'll HMAC sign that file and produce a notarization PDF with the HMAC digest and a short explanatory paragraph.

Attachments uploaded to a staging bucket for now; Irene — can you confirm the Vendr profile upload and generate presigned GET links with a 72-hour window? We should also push a copy to our internal secure bucket and include the S3-presigned PUT proof if Brightleaf prefers that flow.

- Attachments included: sig_manifest.csv, artifact-hashes.txt

Mina
Senior Compliance Engineer
